cases.expected: asOf: 200 regionCode NORTH, header X-View-As-Of=<date>; live: SOUTH (PRD B3 "which region a record belonged to then"; DESIGN §8.3 CustomerRegionMoveTest)

cases.title: Region-filtered lists as of before the move put the invoices in North, and live in South; PageResponse echoes asOf and regionIds
cases.steps: admin GET /api/invoices?regionIds=N&asOf=<past>&filter=customerId:eq:<id>; same live; same with regionIds=S
cases.expected: past N: 2 rows, asOf=<past>, regionIds [N]; live N: 0; live S: 2; past S: 0

cases.title: A North-only reader can still see, as of before the move, a customer that has since left North
cases.steps: bob-like check with nora? nora holds N+S; use wendy-free: create user nell MANAGE North only; GET /api/customers/{id}?asOf=<past>; live
cases.expected: asOf: 200 (the record was in North then; current grants applied to region at T, DESIGN D9); live: 404
